meta.name: Tarzan, the Ape Man
meta.description: The Tarzan story from Jane's point of view. Jane Parker visits her father in Africa where she joins him on an expedition. A couple of brief encounters with Tarzan establish a (sexual) bond between her and Tarzan. When the expedition is captured by savages, Tarzan comes to the rescue.
meta.slogan: The most beautiful woman of our time in the most erotic adventure of all time.
